newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: IRANIAN PRESIDENT TO INSPECT QUAKE AREA.
newsitem.headline: IRANIAN PRESIDENT TO INSPECT QUAKE AREA.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani on Monday interrupted a tour of former Soviet republics to visit areas in eastern Iran struck by an earthquake that killed nearly 2,400 people, Iran's foreign minister said.

"Our president is leaving Ashgabat for the earthquake zone in Birjand," the foreign minister, Ali Akbar Velayati, told Reuters in Turkmenistan. "He will give instructions to the local authorities on how to cope and deal with the crisis."
Iranian diplomats said Rafsanjani would fly back to Turkmenistan later in the day to continue his tour.
Saturday's force 7.1 earthquake killed nearly 2,400 people in eastern Iran and displaced 50,000. Iran has appealed for international help.
